end.summary:
Asha discussed Diwali, rangoli, sweets, new clothes, and harvest festivals across India.
Kavya identified that “harvest” means cutting crops.
They linked the new rice crop to the timing of a harvest festival once without help.
Kavya continued to say festival dates and farming have no clear link; this was not corrected after the last mention.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised connecting harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready and named Pongal, Makar Sankranti, and Lohri. They correctly explained once that a festival can occur when a new rice crop is ready. The farming-and-festival connection was still mixed up later, so at home you can match one festival, its crop, and its harvest season using a simple three-column chart.
